external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer. They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and uses the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state whether the payer is a customer user.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: An agent who works from the support office network and uses the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users and support agents.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: The app handles invoices, customers, payout bank details, authentication, invoice editing, PDF requests and payment pages.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices and creates PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: It trusts the company ID carried by each job.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The console used by support agents to open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The console is reachable only from the support office network. Its runtime placement is not stated.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The database has no row-level security and the app connects with one database account for all companies.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue holding PDF render jobs containing a company ID and an invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state where the queue runs or how it is protected at rest.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket containing rendered PDFs stored under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: one PDF bucket in our cloud platform
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies. The text does not state how the bucket is protected at rest.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Customer user submits sign-in credentials to the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.
data_flows.notes: No second factor is used for admins or viewers.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: Email address, password and session cookie

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: Customer user uses the billing app to view and edit invoicing information.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.notes: The text states that users can open invoices and submit invoice edits.
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer information and payout bank details

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: Payer follows an invoice link and views the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state the protocol used by the payer.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name and bank details

data_flows.name: send invoice link
data_flows.description: Billing app sends the payer an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link containing an invoice number

data_flows.name: query tenant database
data_flows.description: Billing app reads and writes tenant records in the shared database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app uses one database account for all companies. It reads invoices and saves invoice edits.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers and payout bank details

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: Billing app puts a PDF render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue. The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: take render jobs
data_flows.description: PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: PDF render jobs containing a company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by the job.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice data

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: PDF renderer writes the rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDFs
data_flows.description: Billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: use admin console
data_flows.description: Support agent signs in to and uses the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.notes: The admin console is reachable only from the support office network.
data_flows.data_description: Agent account credentials and one-time code

data_flows.name: open customer session
data_flows.description: Admin console opens a billing-app session as a customer user at an agent's request.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state the protocol or authentication mechanism used between the console and billing app.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session

trust_boundaries.name: customer company tenant
trust_boundaries.description: The tenant boundary associated with a customer company and its users.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform containing the shared billing app, tenant database and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform.
